data.long_meaning: The name Noam is derived from the Hebrew language and translates to 'rest, tranquility, or comfort.' In the Old Testament, Noam is the name of a man who builds a city and names it after his deceased son. The name Noam carries the meaning “Rest, tranquility, or comfort” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Noam usually hope their child will grow to embody rest, tranquility, or comfort and live with faith, good character and purpose.
